review_comments.body:
** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Hold the directory lock in the smoke script.** `dev-notify-smoke.sh` still holds a lock on `com.fleetdm.fleet-desktop.notify.lock` in the temporary directory. `notify` now locks the temporary directory itself, so the held file lock does not block it. The `expect 50` check no longer reaches the contention branch. Change the lock holder to take an exclusive `flock` on the same temporary directory that `notify` uses, `${TMPDIR:-$(getconf DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR)}`. Keep the `expect 50` assertion. The `lockf -k` holder can't be reused as-is because it targets a file path.

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the fix and the affected component: notify stacking toasts when the lock file is removed. It matches the main change, which locks the per-user temp directory instead of the lock file, so a deleted lock file no longer lets a second toast open. The title is specific and concise.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the template's main sections: related issue, a checklist with the changes file box checked, a Testing section, and an AI section with tool and model. It also gives root cause, fix, and reproduction steps, which go beyond the template. Several template items are unchecked, but the ones that apply to this change are either addressed or explained: no automated tests because the app has no Swift test target, and manual QA not run on macOS. The Frontend, database, MDM, GitOps, and fleetd sections are not filled in, but they do not apply to a macOS desktop lock change. The description is mostly complete. The reviewer should check that the AI section names the model ID exactly as the environment reports it.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#58621` requires that a second `notify` exit 50 while a toast is displayed, even after the lock file is deleted. At the reviewed head, `acquireToastLock()` in `NotifyCommand.swift` opens `NSTemporaryDirectory()` with `O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_CLOEXEC` and takes `flock(LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)` on that descriptor. The lock now targets a directory inode that `notify` does not create or delete. Deleting the old lock file no longer creates a second independent lock. The existing `flock` failure path still returns the lock-held result that maps to exit 50, and the kernel releases the lock when the holding process exits. The change does not add automated tests. The author states that the app has no Swift test target. The author also states that macOS runtime behavior was not run. The code change itself is coherent with the requirement. The runtime behavior on macOS remains unverified by this review.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR diff (merge base 6877207 to head 56fa77d) changes only `acquireToastLock()` in `NotifyCommand.swift`, adding a doc comment and replacing the lock-file open with a directory open. It also adds the changes entry `apps/fleet-desktop-macos/changes/58621-notify-lock-unlink`. Both changes directly implement or document the fix for `#58621`. No unrelated changes were found.
